verdict.rationale:
Thoropass's 'Unified Controls' concept is well documented: auditors map all supported frameworks to a single core control list (thoropass-docs-37), controls can be filtered/grouped by framework in the Compliance Roadmap (thoropass-docs-38), and multi-framework action items eliminate duplicate work when adding a new framework like HIPAA (thoropass-docs-40, thoropass-docs-59, thoropass-docs-13, thoropass-docs-12, thoropass-docs-14). This directly matches the story of work counting across SOC 2/ISO/HIPAA with overlap visible via framework filtering.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that overlap percentages or exact evidence reuse are visually surfaced, and no third-party case study confirming the claimed efficiency.
